'''Goblin Raiders''' are raiders who are involved in [[Goblin Raids]], led by [[Hollowtoof]]. They drop items relevant to what they're raiding. When raiding they shout various phrases such as "Got one!" , "Hur hur hur!" and "I got a ..." They appear to be wielding the [[raider axe]].

===Raided drops===
These raiders will shout various phrases, and each time they shout this, one roll for a raided drop ([[logs]] for a wood-gathering goblin, [[seeds]] for a goblin on a farm, [[stone spirit]]s for a mine) is added to that goblin. When it is killed, they drop all of it. For example, if a goblin raider is cutting trees and yells three quotes, then the player has three rolls on the raided logs drop table. These are dropped in addition to a main drop and any other tertiary drops.

The quality of resource is not limited to the source they are targeting. A Raider gathering at a normal [[tree]] can drop [[yew logs]], for example.

==Trivia==
* Before the update on [[26 May]] [[2015]], goblin raids were only accessible to [[members]].
* Their examine text is a reference to the {{Wp|Smash and grab|crime of the same name}}.
* They can yell "I got a plank!" even though they cannot drop [[plank]]s, only logs. It could be that they aren't intelligent enough to distinguish logs from planks.
* Since the [[Mining and Smithing rework]], they no longer shout and raid at mining sites.
